tbesh_html:
1) to lend on interest or usury, be a creditor
1a) (Qal) creditor (participle)
1b) (Hiphil) to act as a creditor

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to lend on interest; by implication, to dun fordebt
strongs_1890.derivation: a primitive root (perhaps identical with H5377 (נָשָׁא), through the idea of imposition);
